body:
**Source:** the owner's ticketing standard (2026-09-28), story S13







A library crate holding the six label dimensions, the flags, and the kind/risk/surface/effort/origin/ready/triage rules as pure functions over a parsed ticket. Abstention is a value, not an error. Blocked on the ADR ticket.







**Acceptance:**



- `cargo test -p trellis-tickets` passes



- Each rule has a test naming the input that makes it abstain



- The crate depends only on trellis-core

**Files:** Cargo.toml (workspace members already glob `crates/*`); crates/trellis-tickets/Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/rules.rs, src/labels.rs (new)

## Decision
Yes: typed `Outcome<T>` with `Decided` and `Abstained`, one pure function per dimension, `TRIAGE_VERSION = 2`, and the standard committed as `docs/TICKETING.md` first. Waits on #75 and #76 (blocked_by). Labels lowered (surface:public -> surface:cli) because the owner decided this on 2026-09-28; that answer is the release, so `scripts/tickets/next.sh` may admit it.

Decided 2026-09-28 by the owner, via the coordinator.

## Done when
- `docs/TICKETING.md` holds the ticketing standard's text before any rule is written.
- `crates/trellis-tickets` exists (workspace member, depends only on `trellis-core`), exporting `pub enum Outcome<T> { Decided { value: T, rule: &'static str }, Abstained { rule: &'static str, reason: String } }` and one pure function per dimension (`area`, `kind`, `risk`, `surface`, `effort`, `origin`, `flags`, `ready`, `triage`) over a `Ticket { title, body, labels, state }`.
- No I/O in the library; `TRIAGE_VERSION = 2`.
- Nine tests named `abstains_*`, one abstention per dimension.

## Verify
```
scripts/tickets/verify-tests.sh trellis-tickets abstains_ 9
git ls-files --error-unmatch docs/TICKETING.md
```

Pre-check on drain 50b3295: exit 1

<!-- triage:start (generated; do not hand-edit) -->

## Tasks

- [ ] Add crates/trellis-tickets to the workspace
- [ ] Define label enums and the Ticket input type
- [ ] Implement each rule as a pure function returning a value or an abstention
- [ ] Add per-rule tests including abstentions

## Triage

```yaml
story: S13
labels: [area:cli, kind:feature, risk:medium, surface:public, effort:m, origin:manual]
flags: [!agent-ok, !needs-adr]
triage: blocked
triage_reasons: ["depends on open #75"]
ready: false
ready_failures: ["blocked by #75 (OPEN)"]
blocked_by: [75]
triaged_at: 2026-09-28T21:13:17Z
triage_version: 2
```

<!-- triage:end -->

title: Add the trellis-tickets crate with the label schema and rule engine
